baseline.target_p95_note: No p95 target exists; p90 is an observed local result and the remote baseline is established separately in W13.

room_grouping.reason: Room matching is not the dominant measured phase and equivalent rooms keep distinct physical identities; grouping would weaken publication and audit without a measured gain.

baseline.stop_policy_note: The stopping policy is an offline candidate only. Online evaluation on a reserved family did not confirm a saving at the tested budget, so it is not activated and the full safety budget remains in force; adoption requires owner acceptance and a confirming reserved experiment.
